title: Professional portfolio va karyera
goal_uz: Dars oxirida til darajangizni dalillar bilan ko‘rsatasiz, inglizcha LinkedIn profilini yozasiz, tanishuv va keyingi xabar uchun aniq iboralarni ishlatasiz va olti oylik o‘qish rejasini tuzasiz.

scenes.title: Til bilimingizni karyeraga aylantiring
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda gapirish imtihoniga tayyorlandik. Bugun darsning amaliy natijasi haqida gaplashamiz: ingliz tilini karyerangizda qanday ko‘rsatish va rivojlantirish. Dars oxirida siz til darajangizni dalillar bilan isbotlaysiz, inglizcha professional profil yozasiz, yangi odamlar bilan tanishish iboralarini ishlatasiz va olti oylik rejani tuzasiz. Sertifikatning o‘zi yetarli emas, ish beruvchi sizning tilingiz bilan nima qila olishingizni ko‘rishni xohlaydi. Uyga vazifa esa shu portfolio va rejani yaratish.
scenes.say: Good to see you again. Last time we prepared for the speaking exam. Today we turn your English into career capital. You will show your level with evidence, write a professional profile, network with confidence and plan the next six months of learning. A certificate is useful, but employers want to see what you can do with the language.
scenes.say_uz: Sizni yana ko‘rganimdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar gapirish imtihoniga tayyorlandik. Bugun inglizchangizni karyera kapitaliga aylantiramiz. Darajangizni dalil bilan ko‘rsatasiz, profil yozasiz, ishonch bilan tanishasiz va keyingi olti oyni rejalashtirasiz. Sertifikat foydali, lekin ish beruvchilar tilingiz bilan nima qila olishingizni ko‘rishni xohlaydi.

scenes.title: Til darajasi dalillari
board: Certificate: IELTS / Cambridge C1 · date · score
Work samples: report · presentation · recorded talk

examples.t: I hold an IELTS Academic certificate with an overall band of seven point five.
examples.uz: Menda IELTS Academic sertifikati bor, umumiy ball yetti butun besh.

examples.t: I can negotiate contracts and deliver presentations to international clients.
examples.uz: Men xalqaro mijozlarga shartnomalar bo‘yicha muzokara olib bora olaman va taqdimotlar o‘tkaza olaman.

examples.t: A short recording of my conference talk is available on request.
examples.uz: Konferensiyadagi nutqimning qisqa yozuvi so‘rov bo‘yicha mavjud.

scenes.say_native: Til darajasini isbotlashning to‘rtta yo‘li bor. Birinchi: rasmiy sertifikat — IELTS, TOEFL yoki Cambridge, ball va sanani ko‘rsating. Sertifikat odatda ikki yil amal qiladi deb hisoblanadi, shuning uchun sanasi muhim. Ikkinchi: ish namunalari — yozgan hisobotingiz, o‘tkazgan taqdimotingiz, yozib olingan nutq. Uchinchi: „can-do“ gaplar: „I can negotiate contracts and deliver presentations to international clients“. Bu daraja nomi emas, aniq qobiliyatni ko‘rsatadi. To‘rtinchi: tavsiyalar, ya’ni hamkasbning „testimonial“ i. Agar sizda hali sertifikat bo‘lmasa, ish namunalari va can-do gaplar kuchli o‘rin tutadi.
scenes.say: There are four ways to prove your level. First, an official certificate, with the score and date. Second, work samples, such as a report, a presentation or a recorded talk. Third, can-do statements: I can negotiate contracts and deliver presentations to international clients. These describe real ability, not just a level name. Fourth, testimonials from colleagues.
scenes.say_uz: Darajani isbotlashning to‘rt yo‘li: rasmiy sertifikat, ball va sanasi bilan; ish namunalari; can-do gaplar, ular daraja nomini emas, haqiqiy qobiliyatni ko‘rsatadi; va hamkasblarning tavsiyalari.

scenes.title: Xato: bo‘sh da’volar
board: ✓ I deliver weekly client calls in English.

examples.t: I lead weekly client calls in English with partners in three countries.
examples.uz: Uch mamlakatdagi hamkorlar bilan haftalik mijoz qo‘ng‘iroqlarini inglizcha olib boraman.

examples.t: Professional working proficiency, supported by IELTS 7.5.
examples.uz: Professional ishchi darajasi, IELTS 7,5 bilan tasdiqlangan.

scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — dalilsiz maqtanish: „I have excellent English“. Bu har kim yozadigan gap, ishonch uyg‘otmaydi. Aniqroq yozing: „I lead weekly client calls in English with partners in three countries“. Ikkinchi xato — „fluent“ so‘zini isbotsiz ishlatish. Buning o‘rniga LinkedIn kabi platformalarda keng ishlatiladigan darajalar bor: „professional working proficiency“ — professional ishchi daraja. Uchinchi xato — o‘zingiz o‘ylab topgan daraja: „advanced++“. Rasmiy shkala ishlating: CEFR C1 yoki ball. Shunda ish beruvchi tushunadi. O‘zbek rezyumelarida ko‘pincha „ingliz tili — yaxshi“ yoziladi, bu yerda esa konkret bo‘lish kerak.
scenes.say: The most common mistake is an empty claim: I have excellent English. Everyone writes that. Be specific: I lead weekly client calls in English with partners in three countries. Do not use fluent without proof. Use recognised labels such as professional working proficiency, supported by a score. And avoid invented levels like advanced plus plus.
scenes.say_uz: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — bo‘sh da’vo: I have excellent English. Aniq yozing: uch mamlakatdagi hamkorlar bilan haftalik qo‘ng‘iroqlarni inglizcha olib boraman. Fluent so‘zini isbotsiz ishlatmang. Tanilgan belgilar va ball ishlating, o‘zingiz o‘ylab topgan darajalardan saqlaning.

scenes.title: Mashq: can-do gap yozing
board: Write 2 can-do statements about English at work
scenes.say_native: Siz logistika koordinatorisiz. Ishdagi inglizchangiz haqida ikkita can-do gap ayting. Har birida fe’l, kontekst va natija bo‘lsin. Masalan, nima qilasiz, kim bilan va qanday natija bilan. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: You work as a logistics coordinator. Give two can-do statements about your English at work. Each one should contain a verb, a context and a result.
scenes.say_uz: Siz logistika koordinatorisiz. Ishdagi inglizchangiz haqida ikkita can-do gap ayting. Har birida fe’l, kontekst va natija bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Javob: can-do gaplar
board: I negotiate delivery terms with suppliers in English.
I write clear shipment reports for overseas clients.

examples.t: I negotiate delivery terms with European suppliers, which has shortened lead times by ten per cent.
examples.uz: Yevropa yetkazib beruvchilari bilan yetkazib berish shartlarini muzokara qilaman, bu muddatni o‘n foizga qisqartirdi.

examples.t: I write shipment reports that overseas clients can act on immediately.
examples.uz: Chet eldagi mijozlar darhol amal qila oladigan yuk hisobotlarini yozaman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. Birinchi: „I negotiate delivery terms with European suppliers, which has shortened lead times by ten per cent.“ Ikkinchi: „I write shipment reports that overseas clients can act on immediately.“ Birinchisida fe’l — „negotiate“, kontekst — yetkazib beruvchilar, natija — o‘n foiz. „Lead time“ — buyurtmadan yetkazishgacha vaqt. „Act on“ — asosida harakat qilmoq. Ikkinchi gapda natija raqamsiz, lekin aniq foyda ko‘rsatilgan. Mavjud raqam bo‘lsa, albatta qo‘shing, chunki raqam ishonchni oshiradi. Siz o‘z sohangizdan olgan fe’l, kontekst va natija bilan yozgan bo‘lsangiz, mashq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: Model answers. I negotiate delivery terms with European suppliers, which has shortened lead times by ten per cent. I write shipment reports that overseas clients can act on immediately. The first has a verb, a context and a measurable result. Whenever you have a number, add it, because numbers build trust.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. Yevropa yetkazib beruvchilari bilan yetkazib berish shartlarini muzokara qilaman, bu muddatni o‘n foizga qisqartirdi. Chet eldagi mijozlar darhol amal qila oladigan yuk hisobotlarini yozaman. Birinchisida fe’l, kontekst va o‘lchanadigan natija bor. Raqam bo‘lsa, qo‘shing.

scenes.title: LinkedIn uslubidagi profil

examples.t: Logistics coordinator | Cutting delivery times for European retailers
examples.uz: Logistika koordinatori | Yevropa chakana savdosi uchun yetkazib berish muddatini qisqartiraman

examples.t: I help companies move goods faster and with fewer errors.
examples.uz: Kompaniyalarga tovarni tezroq va kamroq xato bilan yetkazishda yordam beraman.

examples.t: Reduced delivery errors by 18 per cent by redesigning the packing checklist.
examples.uz: Qadoqlash ro‘yxatini qayta ishlab chiqib, yetkazish xatolarini o‘n sakkiz foizga kamaytirdim.

scenes.say_native: LinkedIn profilining uch asosiy qismi bor. Sarlavha, ya’ni „headline“: lavozim, qiymat va kalit so‘zlar: „Logistics coordinator | Cutting delivery times for European retailers“. „About“ bo‘limida birinchi jumla qiziqtirsin: „I help companies move goods faster and with fewer errors“. Keyin dalillar va kelajak yo‘nalishi. „Experience“ da har bir punkt kuchli fe’l bilan boshlansin va natija bo‘lsin: „Reduced delivery errors by eighteen per cent by redesigning the packing checklist“. E’tibor bering: o‘tgan zamon fe’li, shaxs olmoshi „I“ siz. Profil birinchi shaxsda ham yoziladi, lekin tajriba punktlarida „I“ tushiriladi. Bu rezyume uslubi.
scenes.say: A professional profile has three main parts. The headline combines role, value and keywords: logistics coordinator, cutting delivery times for European retailers. In the About section, start with a hook: I help companies move goods faster and with fewer errors. In Experience, start each bullet with a strong past tense verb and include a result: reduced delivery errors by eighteen per cent by redesigning the packing checklist.
scenes.say_uz: Profilning uch qismi bor. Sarlavhada lavozim, qiymat va kalit so‘zlar birlashadi. About bo‘limida qiziqtiruvchi jumla bilan boshlang. Tajriba punktlarini kuchli o‘tgan zamon fe’li bilan boshlang va natijani qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Xato: profil xatolari
board: ✗ I am looking for any job

examples.t: Led a team of six to launch the new customer portal in four months.
examples.uz: Olti kishilik jamoani boshqarib, yangi mijoz portalini to‘rt oyda ishga tushirdim.

examples.t: I am seeking a role where I can improve supply chain efficiency.
examples.uz: Ta’minot zanjiri samaradorligini oshira oladigan lavozim izlayapman.

scenes.say_native: Profilda uchta keng tarqalgan xato bor. Birinchisi — „Responsible for…“ bilan boshlash: bu vazifani sanaydi, yutuqni emas. Buning o‘rniga „Led“, „Built“, „Reduced“, „Launched“ kabi fe’llarni ishlating: „Led a team of six to launch the new customer portal in four months“. Ikkinchisi — „hardworking“, „team player“, „motivated“ kabi har kim yozadigan sifatlar. Bu so‘zlarni faktlar bilan almashtiring. Uchinchisi — „I am looking for any job“: bu qiziqish yo‘qligini ko‘rsatadi. Aniq yo‘nalishni ayting: „I am seeking a role where I can improve supply chain efficiency“. „Seek“ — izlamoq, rasmiyroq ohangli fe’l. Grammatik jihatdan o‘tgan zamonni va fe’l birinchi qo‘shilishini kuzating.
scenes.say: Three common mistakes. Starting with responsible for, which lists duties instead of achievements. Use led, built, reduced or launched: led a team of six to launch the new customer portal in four months. Using empty adjectives like hardworking and team player; replace them with facts. And writing I am looking for any job. Name a direction: I am seeking a role where I can improve supply chain efficiency.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xato. Responsible for bilan boshlash vazifani sanaydi, yutuqni emas; led, built, reduced, launched ishlating. Hardworking kabi bo‘sh sifatlarni faktlar bilan almashtiring. Any job demang, aniq yo‘nalishni ayting.

scenes.title: Mashq: tajriba punktini yozing
board: Responsible for organising training sessions for new staff.
Rewrite with an action verb and result
scenes.say_native: Quyidagi gapni kuchli punktga aylantiring: „Yangi xodimlar uchun o‘quv mashg‘ulotlarini tashkil qilish uchun mas’ul edim.“ Faktlar: o‘n ikki mashg‘ulot, yuz ellik xodim, mamnunlik besh balldan 4,6. Kuchli fe’l bilan boshlang va natijani qo‘shing. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite this weak line: responsible for organising training sessions for new staff. The facts are twelve sessions, one hundred and fifty staff and a satisfaction score of four point six out of five. Start with an action verb and include the result.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kuchsiz gapni qayta yozing: yangi xodimlar uchun o‘quv mashg‘ulotlarini tashkil qilishga mas’ul. Faktlar: o‘n ikki mashg‘ulot, yuz ellik xodim, mamnunlik besh balldan 4,6. Kuchli fe’l bilan boshlang va natijani qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javob: kuchli punkt
board: Organised twelve training sessions for 150 new staff,
achieving a satisfaction score of 4.6 out of 5.

examples.t: Organised twelve training sessions for one hundred and fifty new employees, achieving a satisfaction score of 4.6 out of 5.
examples.uz: Yuz ellik yangi xodim uchun o‘n ikki mashg‘ulot tashkil etib, mamnunlik balli 5 dan 4,6 ga erishdim.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „Organised twelve training sessions for one hundred and fifty new employees, achieving a satisfaction score of 4.6 out of 5.“ Bu yerda fe’l o‘tgan zamonda, „Organised“. Keyin raqamlar: o‘n ikki, yuz ellik, 4,6. Oxirida „achieving“ — ing shakli — natijani qo‘shib beradi. Boshqa variantlar: „Delivered“, „Ran“, „Coordinated“. „Satisfaction score“ — mamnunlik balli. E’tibor bering, gap „I“ siz, bu rezyume uslubi. Agar sizning variantingizda kuchli fe’l va kamida bitta raqam bo‘lsa, javob to‘g‘ri. Raqamlar bo‘lmasa, „significantly“ ni ishlatmang, aniq natijani ayting.
scenes.say: A model line. Organised twelve training sessions for one hundred and fifty new employees, achieving a satisfaction score of four point six out of five. It starts with a past tense verb, adds figures and ends with the result in an ing form. Other strong verbs are delivered, ran and coordinated. There is no I, which is the standard CV style.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy gap. Yuz ellik yangi xodim uchun o‘n ikki mashg‘ulot tashkil etib, mamnunlik balli 5 dan 4,6 ga erishdim. U o‘tgan zamon fe’li bilan boshlanadi, raqamlar qo‘shiladi va natija ing shaklida beriladi. Boshqa kuchli fe’llar: delivered, ran, coordinated. Rezyumeda I ishlatilmaydi.

scenes.title: Tanishuv rejasi (networking)
board: Opening: What brings you to this event?
Give value: I recently read… might help

examples.t: What brings you to this conference?
examples.uz: Sizni bu konferensiyaga nima olib keldi?

examples.t: It was great meeting you at the logistics forum. I thought you might find this article useful.
examples.uz: Logistika forumida tanishganimdan xursandman. Bu maqola sizga foydali bo‘lishi mumkin deb o‘yladim.

examples.t: Would you be open to a short call next week?
examples.uz: Kelasi hafta qisqa qo‘ng‘iroqqa ochiqmisiz?

scenes.say_native: Networking — foyda olishdan oldin foyda berish. Tadbirda suhbatni ochiq savol bilan boshlang: „What brings you to this conference?“ — sizni bu yerga nima olib keldi. Suhbat oxirida qiziqish bildiring va aloqa so‘rang. Qirq sakkiz soat ichida qisqa xabar yuboring: „It was great meeting you at the logistics forum. I thought you might find this article useful.“ Bu yerda „you might find“ — sizga foydali bo‘lishi mumkin, yumshoq tavsiya. Yangi kontaktga bir yo‘la ish so‘ramang, avval qisqa suhbat taklif qiling: „Would you be open to a short call next week?“ Oylik reja: ikkita tadbir va beshta shaxsiy xabar. O‘zbek madaniyatida tanish-bilish katta rol o‘ynaydi, inglizcha professional muhitda esa uni aniq tilda qurish kerak.
scenes.say: Networking means giving before asking. At an event, open with a question: what brings you to this conference? Within forty-eight hours, send a short message: it was great meeting you at the logistics forum. I thought you might find this article useful. Do not ask for a job at once. Ask for a short call: would you be open to a short call next week?
scenes.say_uz: Networking — so‘rashdan oldin berish. Tadbirda savol bilan boshlang: sizni bu konferensiyaga nima olib keldi? Qirq sakkiz soat ichida qisqa xabar yuboring. Darhol ish so‘ramang, qisqa qo‘ng‘iroqni taklif qiling.

scenes.title: Xato: networking xatolari
board: ✗ Can you give me a job?

examples.t: I would value your perspective on moving into supply chain analytics.
examples.uz: Ta’minot zanjiri tahlili sohasiga o‘tish bo‘yicha fikringizni qadrlagan bo‘lardim.

examples.t: Hi Daniel, I enjoyed your talk on automation. I would love to connect.
examples.uz: Salom Daniel, avtomatlashtirish haqidagi nutqingiz yoqdi. Bog‘lanishni istardim.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato — darhol ish so‘rash: „Can you give me a job?“ Bu tanish emas, bosim. Yaxshisi: „I would value your perspective on moving into supply chain analytics“ — ushbu soha bo‘yicha fikringizni qadrlagan bo‘lardim. Ikkinchi xato — izohsiz „connect“ so‘rovi. Qisqa shaxsiy gap yozing: „I enjoyed your talk on automation. I would love to connect“. Uchinchi xato — tanishgandan keyin hech qachon aloqaga chiqmaslik; bir oy o‘tgach, aloqa o‘chadi. „Perspective“ — nuqtai nazar, „would love to“ — juda xohlayman. Muloyim va aniq bo‘ling, boshqa odamning vaqtini qadrlang.
scenes.say: The first mistake is asking for a job immediately: can you give me a job? That is pressure, not a relationship. Say: I would value your perspective on moving into supply chain analytics. The second is sending a connection request without a note. Add one line: I enjoyed your talk on automation. I would love to connect. The third is never following up, so the contact goes cold.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xato — darhol ish so‘rash, bu bosim. Ta’minot zanjiri tahliliga o‘tish bo‘yicha fikringizni qadrlagan bo‘lardim, deng. Ikkinchisi — izohsiz connect so‘rovi, bitta shaxsiy gap qo‘shing. Uchinchisi — aloqaga chiqmaslik, shunda kontakt sovib ketadi.

scenes.title: Mashq: keyingi xabar
board: You met Maria, a procurement manager, at a fair.
scenes.say_native: Siz yarmarkada xaridlar menejeri Mariya bilan tanishdingiz. U yetkazib beruvchilarni audit qilish haqida gapirdi. Uch gaplik keyingi xabarni ayting: tanishuvdan minnatdorchilik, suhbatdagi mavzuga havola va qisqa qo‘ng‘iroq taklifi. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: You met Maria, a procurement manager, at a trade fair. She mentioned supplier audits. Give a three-sentence follow-up message: thanks for the meeting, a reference to your conversation and an invitation to a short call.
scenes.say_uz: Siz savdo yarmarkasida xaridlar menejeri Mariya bilan tanishdingiz. U yetkazib beruvchilar auditini aytib o‘tdi. Uch gaplik xabar ayting: tanishuv uchun rahmat, suhbatga havola va qisqa qo‘ng‘iroq taklifi.

scenes.title: Javob: follow-up xabar
board: Dear Maria, thank you for the conversation…
Would you be open to a 15-minute call?

examples.t: Would you be open to a fifteen-minute call to share how your team approaches audits?
examples.uz: Jamoangiz auditga qanday yondashishini bilish uchun o‘n besh daqiqalik qo‘ng‘iroqqa ochiqmisiz?

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy xabar: „Dear Maria, thank you for the conversation at the trade fair on Tuesday. I found your comments on supplier audits very interesting, particularly the point about unannounced visits. Would you be open to a fifteen-minute call to share how your team approaches them?“ Uch qism: minnatdorchilik, suhbatga aniq havola, qisqa iltimos. „Particularly“ — ayniqsa, „unannounced“ — oldindan ogohlantirilmagan. O‘n besh daqiqa — kichik va rozilik berishga oson so‘rov. Sizning xabaringizda mavzuga aniq havola bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model message. Dear Maria, thank you for the conversation at the trade fair on Tuesday. I found your comments on supplier audits very interesting, particularly the point about unannounced visits. Would you be open to a fifteen-minute call to share how your team approaches them? It has thanks, a specific reference and a small, easy request.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy xabar. Hurmatli Mariya, seshanba kungi yarmarkadagi suhbat uchun rahmat. Yetkazib beruvchilar auditi haqidagi fikrlaringiz, ayniqsa oldindan ogohlantirilmagan tashriflar haqidagisi, menga juda qiziq tuyuldi. Jamoangiz bunga qanday yondashishini bilish uchun o‘n besh daqiqalik qo‘ng‘iroqqa ochiqmisiz? Rahmat, aniq havola va kichik iltimos bor.

scenes.title: Umrbod o‘qish rejasi

examples.t: My goal is to lead a client meeting in English by the end of June.
examples.uz: Maqsadim iyun oxirigacha mijoz yig‘ilishini inglizcha boshqarish.

examples.t: I will study thirty minutes a day and record one talk a week.
examples.uz: Kuniga o‘ttiz daqiqa o‘qiyman va haftada bitta nutq yozib olaman.

examples.t: At the end of month three, I will review my recordings with a mentor.
examples.uz: Uchinchi oy oxirida yozuvlarimni ustoz bilan ko‘rib chiqaman.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi o‘qish rejasi to‘rt qismdan iborat: maqsad, harakatlar, o‘lchov va qayta ko‘rib chiqish. Maqsad: „I want to lead a client meeting in English by the end of June“. Harakatlar: „I will study thirty minutes a day and record one talk a week“. Muhim qoida: har kuni o‘ttiz daqiqa — oyiga bir marta to‘rt soatdan ancha yaxshi, chunki til takrorlashda o‘sadi. Mashg‘ulot uch qismdan iborat bo‘lsin: kirish, ya’ni o‘qish va tinglash; chiqish, ya’ni gapirish va yozish; va fikr-mulohaza, ya’ni ustoz yoki tekshiruv. Birinchi, uchinchi va oltinchi oylarda oraliq maqsad qo‘ying. Reja har oyda qayta ko‘rib chiqilsin, aks holda u kitob javonida qoladi.
scenes.say: A good learning plan has four parts: a goal, actions, measures and a review. My goal is to lead a client meeting in English by the end of June. I will study thirty minutes a day and record one talk a week. Thirty minutes daily beats four hours once a month. Balance input, output and feedback, and set milestones at months one, three and six.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi o‘qish rejasi to‘rt qismdan iborat: maqsad, harakatlar, o‘lchov va qayta ko‘rib chiqish. Kuniga o‘ttiz daqiqa oyiga bir marta to‘rt soatdan yaxshiroq. Kirish, chiqish va fikr-mulohazani muvozanatlang, birinchi, uchinchi va oltinchi oyda oraliq maqsad qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Xato: noreal reja
board: ✗ I will become perfect by December.
✓ I will pass a C1 mock test by June.

examples.t: I will score at least 7.0 in a mock speaking test by the end of March.
examples.uz: Mart oxirigacha sinov gapirish testida kamida 7,0 ball olaman.

examples.t: Every Sunday, I review my progress and adjust the plan.
examples.uz: Har yakshanba yutuqlarimni ko‘rib chiqaman va rejani to‘g‘rilayman.

scenes.say_native: Rejadagi uchta xato: birinchi — „I will become perfect by December“. Mukammallik o‘lchanmaydi. Aniqrog‘i: „I will score at least seven in a mock speaking test by the end of March“. Ikkinchi — „study when I have time“. Vaqt o‘z-o‘zidan topilmaydi, jadvalga yozing: „Monday, Wednesday, Friday at seven“. Uchinchi — qayta ko‘rib chiqmaslik. Har yakshanba besh daqiqa ajratib, yutuqni baholang va rejani to‘g‘rilang. Yana bir xato — bir vaqtda hamma narsani o‘rganmoqchi bo‘lish. Bitta asosiy maqsad tanlang. O‘zbek maqolidagi „bir kunda emas, kun sayin“ g‘oyasi shu yerda to‘g‘ri keladi: muntazamlik kuchli.
scenes.say: Three planning mistakes. A vague goal such as I will become perfect by December. Replace it with: I will score at least seven in a mock speaking test by the end of March. Studying whenever you have time, because time does not appear by itself; schedule it. And never reviewing. Every Sunday, review your progress and adjust the plan. Choose one main goal at a time.
scenes.say_uz: Rejada uchta xato. Noaniq maqsad, uni o‘lchanadigan maqsad bilan almashtiring. Vaqt bo‘lsa o‘qiyman deyish, vaqt o‘zi topilmaydi, jadvalga yozing. Qayta ko‘rib chiqmaslik: har yakshanba yutuqni baholang va rejani to‘g‘rilang. Bir vaqtda bitta asosiy maqsadni tanlang.

scenes.title: Mashq: maqsadni aniqlang
board: Vague: I want to improve my business English.
scenes.say_native: Noaniq maqsad: „Ish ingliz tilimni yaxshilamoqchiman.“ Uni aniq, o‘lchanadigan va muddatli qiling, so‘ng bitta haftalik harakat qo‘shing. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The vague goal is: I want to improve my business English. Make it specific, measurable and time-bound, and then add one weekly action.
scenes.say_uz: Noaniq maqsad: ish ingliz tilimni yaxshilamoqchiman. Uni aniq, o‘lchanadigan va muddatli qiling, keyin bitta haftalik harakat qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javob: aniq maqsad
board: By 30 June I will chair a 30-minute meeting in English.
Weekly: record a 3-minute summary of the week.

examples.t: By the thirtieth of June, I will chair a thirty-minute meeting entirely in English.
examples.uz: Iyunning o‘ttizinchisigacha o‘ttiz daqiqalik yig‘ilishni butunlay inglizcha boshqaraman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „By the thirtieth of June, I will chair a thirty-minute team meeting entirely in English. Every week, I will record a three-minute summary of my work and listen for mistakes.“ „Chair a meeting“ — yig‘ilishni boshqarmoq, „entirely“ — butunlay. Maqsadda o‘lchov bor, ya’ni yig‘ilish va o‘ttiz daqiqa, muddat ham aniq: o‘ttizinchi iyun. Haftalik harakat — uch daqiqalik yozuv, bu ham o‘lchanadi. Yozuvlarni tinglash — o‘zini baholash, ya’ni „self-assessment“. Shunday maqsad qo‘yilsa, oy oxirida bajardingizmi yoki yo‘qmi, aniq bilasiz.
scenes.say: A model answer. By the thirtieth of June, I will chair a thirty-minute team meeting entirely in English. Every week, I will record a three-minute summary of my work and listen for mistakes. The goal is measurable and has a deadline, and the weekly action can be checked. Listening back to recordings is a form of self-assessment.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Iyunning o‘ttizinchisigacha o‘ttiz daqiqalik jamoa yig‘ilishini butunlay inglizcha boshqaraman. Har hafta ishim haqida uch daqiqalik xulosani yozib olaman va xatolarni tinglayman. Maqsad o‘lchanadigan va muddatli, haftalik harakat tekshiriladi. Yozuvni tinglash — o‘zini baholash.

scenes.title: Dialog: karyera maslahati
board: What three suggestions does she make?
scenes.say_native: Endi ustoz bilan suhbatni tinglang. Mis Evans Sardorga karyera bo‘yicha maslahat beradi. Sardor nimani xohlaydi va ustoz qanday uchta taklif beradi?
scenes.say: Sardor: I would like to move into project management at an international firm, but I am not sure my English is strong enough. Ms Evans: You already deliver reports in English. Let's make that visible. First, update your headline, then ask your manager for a recommendation. Second, record a short presentation for your portfolio. Third, join two online project management meetups this month. Sardor: That sounds manageable.
scenes.say_uz: Sardor: Xalqaro firmada loyiha boshqaruviga o‘tmoqchiman, lekin inglizchamning yetarli kuchli ekaniga ishonchim komil emas. Mis Evans: Siz hisobotlarni inglizcha topshiryapsiz. Buni ko‘rinadigan qilaylik. Birinchi, sarlavhangizni yangilang va rahbaringizdan tavsiya so‘rang. Ikkinchi, portfolio uchun qisqa taqdimot yozib oling. Uchinchi, shu oy ikkita onlayn loyiha boshqaruvi uchrashuviga qo‘shiling. Sardor: Bu bajarsa bo‘ladigandek.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialog savollari
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Sardor nimani xohlaydi? Ikkinchi: uning tashvishi nima? Uchinchi: uchta taklif qaysilar? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. What does Sardor want? What is his worry? What are the three suggestions?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Sardor nimani xohlaydi? Uning tashvishi nima? Uchta taklif qaysilar?

scenes.title: Javoblar: ustoz maslahati
board: 2) He is unsure his English is strong enough
3) Update headline + recommendation · record a presentation · join two meetups

examples.t: You already deliver reports in English. Let’s make that visible.
examples.uz: Siz hisobotlarni inglizcha topshiryapsiz. Buni ko‘rinadigan qilaylik.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Sardor xalqaro firmada loyiha boshqaruviga o‘tmoqchi. Ikkinchi: u inglizchasi yetarlicha kuchli ekaniga ishonmaydi. Uchinchi: ustoz uchta taklif beradi: sarlavhani yangilash va tavsiya so‘rash, qisqa taqdimotni yozib olish, ikkita onlayn uchrashuvga qo‘shilish. Diqqat qiling, Mis Evans Sardorning allaqachon mavjud yutug‘idan boshladi: hisobotlar. Bu ustozlik uslubi: avval kuchli tomonni ko‘rsat, keyin qadamlar. „Manageable“ — uddalasa bo‘ladigan. „Meetup“ — norasmiy uchrashuv. Uchta qadam kichik va aniq edi, shuning uchun Sardor ularni bajarishga tayyor.
scenes.say: One: Sardor wants to move into project management. Two: he is unsure his English is strong enough. Three: update his headline and ask for a recommendation, record a presentation, and join two online meetups. Notice how Ms Evans starts from what Sardor already does well, his reports, and then gives small, concrete steps. That makes the plan manageable.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Sardor loyiha boshqaruviga o‘tmoqchi. Ikki: inglizchasi yetarlicha kuchli ekaniga ishonchi komil emas. Uch: sarlavhani yangilash va tavsiya so‘rash, taqdimot yozib olish, ikkita onlayn uchrashuvga qo‘shilish. Mis Evans Sardor allaqachon yaxshi qilayotgan narsadan boshlaydi va kichik, aniq qadamlar beradi.

scenes.title: Dialog: suhbat oldidan tanishuv
board: Listen: how does Lina introduce herself?
How does she close the conversation?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — onlayn sohaviy uchrashuvdagi qisqa tanishuv. Tinglang: Lina o‘zini qanday tanishtiradi va suhbatni qanday yakunlaydi?
scenes.say: Lina: Hi, I'm Lina. I work in customer success for a software company in Tashkent. What brings you to the meetup? Tom: I'm hiring analysts. Lina: Interesting. I have just completed a data analytics course and I am looking for ways to apply it. Tom: Send me your profile. Lina: Will do. It was great talking to you, and I will message you tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Lina: Salom, men Linaman. Toshkentdagi dasturiy ta’minot kompaniyasida mijozlar muvaffaqiyati bo‘yicha ishlayman. Sizni uchrashuvga nima olib keldi? Tom: Men tahlilchilar yollayapman. Lina: Qiziq. Men yaqinda ma’lumotlar tahlili kursini tugatdim va uni qo‘llash yo‘llarini qidiryapman. Tom: Profilingizni yuboring. Lina: Albatta. Siz bilan suhbatlashish yoqimli bo‘ldi, ertaga yozaman.

scenes.title: Mashq: tanishuvni tahlil qiling
board: 2) How does Lina connect her course to Tom’s need?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: suhbatni qaysi savol ochadi? Ikkinchi: Lina kursini Tomning ehtiyojiga qanday bog‘laydi? Uchinchi: u nimani va’da qiladi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. Which question opens the conversation? How does Lina connect her course to Tom's need? What does she promise?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Suhbatni qaysi savol ochadi? Lina kursini Tomning ehtiyojiga qanday bog‘laydi? U nimani va’da qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: tanishuv
board: 1) What brings you to the meetup?
2) I have just completed a data analytics course… looking for ways to apply it

examples.t: It was great talking to you, and I will message you tomorrow.
examples.uz: Siz bilan suhbatlashish yoqimli bo‘ldi, ertaga yozaman.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: suhbatni „What brings you to the meetup?“ ochadi. Ikkinchi: Tom tahlilchilar yollayotganini aytgach, Lina „I have just completed a data analytics course“ dedi va uni qo‘llash yo‘llarini izlayotganini qo‘shdi, ya’ni o‘z ko‘nikmasini Tomning ehtiyojiga bog‘ladi. Uchinchi: u ertaga xabar yozishni va’da qildi. „Have just completed“ — hozirgina tugatdim, hozirgi tugallangan zamon. „Will do“ — albatta qilaman, qisqa va tabiiy. Lina o‘zini maqtamadi, balki foydali bo‘lishini ko‘rsatdi. Bu networkingning asosiy sirri: sizning nima qila olishingiz boshqa odamning qanday muammosini hal qiladi.
scenes.say: One: what brings you to the meetup? Two: Tom says he is hiring analysts, so Lina says she has just completed a data analytics course and wants to apply it. She links her skill to his need. Three: she promises to message him tomorrow. Will do is a short, natural way to agree. The secret of networking is to show how your skills solve someone else's problem.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: sizni uchrashuvga nima olib keldi? Ikki: Tom tahlilchi yollayotganini aytgach, Lina ma’lumotlar tahlili kursini tugatganini va uni qo‘llamoqchi ekanini aytadi, ko‘nikmasini uning ehtiyojiga bog‘laydi. Uch: ertaga xabar yozishni va’da qiladi. Networking siri: ko‘nikmangiz boshqaning muammosini qanday hal qilishini ko‘rsating.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: o‘zingizni tanishtiring
board: Who you are · what you do · evidence · what you want
scenes.say_native: O‘z sohangiz bo‘yicha o‘ttiz soniyalik professional tanishtiruv ayting. Siz kimsiz, nima bilan shug‘ullanasiz, bitta dalil yoki raqam va nimani izlayapsiz. Tabiiy va ishonchli gapiring. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Give a thirty-second professional introduction in your own field. Say who you are, what you do, one piece of evidence or a number, and what you are looking for. Sound natural and confident.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z sohangizda o‘ttiz soniyalik professional tanishtiruv ayting. Siz kimsiz, nima qilasiz, bitta dalil yoki raqam va nimani izlayapsiz. Tabiiy va ishonchli bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Javob: tanishtiruv namunasi

examples.t: Last year I helped grow qualified leads by thirty-five per cent, and I am now looking for an international e-commerce role.
examples.uz: O‘tgan yili sifatli mijoz oqimini o‘ttiz besh foizga oshirishga yordam berdim va hozir xalqaro e-commerce lavozimini izlayapman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy tanishtiruv: „Hi, I’m Kamola. I am a marketing analyst at a retail company in Samarkand. Last year I helped grow qualified leads by thirty-five per cent, mostly by improving our email campaigns. I am now looking for an international e-commerce role where I can use my analytics and English every day.“ To‘rt qism bor: kim, nima qiladi, dalil va nimani izlayapti. „Qualified leads“ — mos potentsial mijozlar. „Where I can use“ — qayerda foydalana olaman, bu qismdagi ulovchi so‘z. O‘ttiz soniya taxminan sakkiz-to‘qqiz gap. Sizning tanishtiruvingizda to‘rt qism bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model introduction. Hi, I'm Kamola. I am a marketing analyst at a retail company in Samarkand. Last year I helped grow qualified leads by thirty-five per cent, mostly by improving our email campaigns. I am now looking for an international e-commerce role where I can use my analytics and my English every day. It has four parts: who, what, evidence and goal.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy tanishtiruv. Salom, men Kamolaman. Samarqanddagi chakana savdo kompaniyasida marketing tahlilchisiman. O‘tgan yili asosan email kampaniyalarini yaxshilab, sifatli mijoz oqimini o‘ttiz besh foizga oshirishga yordam berdim. Hozir tahlil va ingliz tilimdan har kuni foydalana oladigan xalqaro e-commerce lavozimini izlayapman. To‘rt qism: kim, nima, dalil va maqsad.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: Profile: headline · About · action verbs + numbers
Networking: give value · follow up in 48 h
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni jamlaymiz. Til darajasini bo‘sh da’vo bilan emas, dalil bilan ko‘rsating: sertifikat, ish namunalari, can-do gaplar va tavsiyalar. Profilda sarlavha qiymatni ifodalasin, tajriba punktlari kuchli fe’l bilan boshlansin va raqamli natijani o‘z ichiga olsin. Networkingda avval foyda bering, qirq sakkiz soat ichida xabar yuboring va qisqa qo‘ng‘iroq taklif qiling. O‘qish rejasida aniq, o‘lchanadigan, muddatli maqsad qo‘ying va muntazam qayta ko‘rib chiqing. Eng muhimi: har kuni kichik qadam. Bugungi tayyorlangan portfolio keyingi ish uchun asos bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Let's review. Show your level with evidence, not empty claims: a certificate, work samples, can-do statements and testimonials. In your profile, make the headline show value, and start each bullet with a strong verb and a result. In networking, give value first, follow up within forty-eight hours and ask for a short call. For your plan, set a specific, measurable, time-bound goal and review it regularly.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. Darajani bo‘sh da’vo bilan emas, dalil bilan ko‘rsating. Profilda sarlavha qiymatni ko‘rsatsin, punktlar kuchli fe’l va natija bilan boshlansin. Networkingda avval foyda bering, qirq sakkiz soat ichida xabar yuboring. Rejada aniq, o‘lchanadigan, muddatli maqsad qo‘ying va muntazam qayta ko‘ring.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Portfolio: headline · About (60 words) · 3 bullets · 2 can-do statements
Plan: 1 goal · weekly actions · milestones at months 1, 3, 6
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: portfolioingiz va olti oylik rejangizni yarating. Portfolioga sarlavha, oltmish so‘zlik „About“ bo‘limi, natijali uchta tajriba punkti va ikkita can-do gap kiriting. Rejada bitta asosiy maqsad, haftalik harakatlar va birinchi, uchinchi va oltinchi oylarda oraliq natijalar bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir punktda kuchli fe’l, kamida ikkita raqam va rejada aniq muddat bor. Keyingi darsda butun PRO 2 modulini takrorlab, yakuniy imtihon topshiramiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to create your portfolio and a six-month plan. Include a headline, a sixty-word About section, three results-based experience bullets and two can-do statements. In the plan, give one main goal, weekly actions and milestones at months one, three and six. Next time we review the whole module and take the final test.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: portfolio va olti oylik reja yarating. Sarlavha, oltmish so‘zlik About bo‘limi, natijali uchta tajriba punkti va ikkita can-do gap kiriting. Rejada bitta asosiy maqsad, haftalik harakatlar va birinchi, uchinchi, oltinchi oylarda oraliq natijalar bo‘lsin. Keyingi safar butun modulni takrorlab, yakuniy testni topshiramiz.

homework_uz: Portfolio va olti oylik reja yarating: sarlavha, 60 so‘zlik About bo‘limi, natijali 3 ta tajriba punkti, 2 ta can-do gap; reja uchun bitta asosiy maqsad, haftalik harakatlar va 1-, 3-, 6-oy oraliq natijalari. Keyingi darsda PRO 2 yakuniy imtihoni bor.

quiz.why_uz: Sarlavha lavozim, qiymat va kalit so‘zlarni beradi.

What brings you to this conference?
